The [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Wraith Four ''' referred to the fourth member of the [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]]. It was first held by [[Eurrsk Thri'ag]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].<ref name="X-Wing" />

After Thri'ag's [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Battle of Ession|battle]] of [[Ession]], the call sign was assigned to [[Dia Passik]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] vehicle specialist.<ref name="IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>

It then passed on to [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]], an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] and one of the original founding Wraiths.<ref name="SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the call sign was assigned to [[Trey Courser]], a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and physical trainer, after the Wraiths were reformed by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Garik Loran]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
